cohort: The study analyzed data from randomized controlled trials involving over 2000 patients undergoing cesarean deliveries, and then applied a cost-effectiveness analysis from the perspective of a high-volume maternity unit.
finding: Carbetocin was found to be cost-effective as prophylaxis against PPH in the context of cesarean section from a pharmacoeconomic perspective.
mod_finding: The findings are specific to cesarean section, demonstrating carbetocin's cost-effectiveness as prophylaxis against PPH in this mode of birth.
